observations.summary: A receipt-aware watchdog now checks the exact public snapshot and immutable receipt, no-ops when healthy, and dispatches the sole canonical publisher only when stale. It never deploys to Netlify directly, so recovery gains do not weaken the no-false-LIVE boundary.
observations.next_quality_threshold: Prove one watchdog-triggered recovery with a matching public timestamp, source commit, content deploy, receipt and visible scoreboards.

observations.summary: The portfolio operating system now has a trigger-independent, receipt-aware recovery contract that preserves validation diagnostics, exact-snapshot ownership and one-publisher architecture while retrying stale publication safely.
observations.next_quality_threshold: Connect recovery outcomes and public receipts to the strategic evidence ledger automatically.

observations.summary: Execution resilience improved through a deterministic recovery loop that detects stale publication evidence and re-dispatches the canonical path without converting retry activity into success evidence.
observations.next_quality_threshold: Measure successful recovery rate, retry cost and time-to-proof from durable source observations.
